composition.type: 36-panel camera angle and pose reference storyboard

subject.description: Young East Asian woman posing in a minimalist photography studio

facial_extraction_details.instructions: Trích xuất từ ảnh upload: Hình dáng khuôn mặt, đặc điểm ngũ quan, màu mắt, kiểu tóc v.v. Extracted strictly from the uploaded input source image. Do not change the underlying face structure. Preserve exact facial features, identity, proportions, skin texture, age, and facial structure. Do not redesign, beautify, or stylize. The generated subject must be the exact same person as the reference across all 36 panels.

features.eyes: Exact match to reference image, including exact eye color
features.skin: Natural realistic texture with visible pores, no artificial smoothing
features.hair: Exact same hairstyle, color and volume from reference

constraints: Use uploaded reference image for exact facial identity.
Maintain 100% facial and wardrobe consistency across all 36 panels.
ALL captions MUST be strictly in Vietnamese.
Number every panel from 1 to 36 in the top-left corner.
